instrumentation: One diagnostic run per variant/case with obc-bench/nav-metrics; timing fields discarded. Timed binaries omit nav-metrics entirely, including existing reader counters.
build_command: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo build --release -p obc-bench --example nav_cost [--features nav-metrics for diagnostics only]
baseline_note: Checkout base_commit and apply baseline-instrumentation.patch. Candidate patch also applies to base_commit. Both timed builds leave optional features disabled.
scope: Shared planner with input maps loaded in host RAM; no terrain, physical SD, device scheduling, or battery claim.

batch_followup.reason: Initial sub-millisecond samples had large overlapping ranges; predeclared cold batches amortize process/frequency noise. No further parameter tuning or repeat campaign.

candidate_commit_note: Unpublished local measured source commit. Replay patches and per-file SHA-256 values reproduce these exact sources without access to that commit. Production commit removes optional counters only.
production_equivalence: Production entry logic is the measured candidate with diagnostic fields/increments removed. They were cfg-disabled in both the whole package tests and timed builds; no runtime logic or memory layout changed during their removal.
